evidence.detail: Exact v308 extends java.awt.GridLayout with the no-arg, rows/cols and rows/cols/hgap/vgap constructors and overrides preferredLayoutSize, minimumLayoutSize and layoutContainer.

The implementation calculates per-column widths and per-row heights from child preferred/minimum dimensions, scales preferred child sizes to the current parent area, then places unequal-sized cells with the same inset/gap traversal as RuneLite DynamicGridLayout.

RuneLite upstream 6e74752caa80fe9cb96cd9b37207e171fa525f07 net.runelite.client.ui.DynamicGridLayout has the same constructors, synchronized tree-lock sizing methods, scaling factors, per-row/column max arrays, layout traversal and shared calculateSize helper.

candidates.note: DynamicGridLayout is recovered at confidence 0.999 from an exact upstream source-name and layout-algorithm match.
